The '''Research Lab''' of [[Project Quell]] was located in the Forgotten Undercity of the [[Tularan Marsh]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and used to study the weaknesses of the [[Rakghoul]]s. When a power surge shut down the security in the facility, the rakghouls burst out and attacked the scientists.<ref name="TOR" />
